messages:
incident-bot: Pager duty — Dedicated routing anomaly detected for customer pools: 2026-07-14 01:08 UTC. Metric spike: router_fallback_rate -> 62%, pool_success_rate -> 28%. Potential immediate customer impact: request errors and headroom exhaustion. Paging alice_oncall. :rotating_light:

alice_oncall: saw it — traffic to dedicated pool dp-west-3 dropped, router started sending traffic to fallback variants. Most requests are 504/timeouts. investigating now.

ben_sre: I'm looking at router metrics and autoscaler heartbeat. router->pool metrics show capacity_signal toggling between 0 and 1 every ~20s. looks like a noisy signal feed, might be interpreted as pool drain.

carol_runtime: Confirmed: policy engine logged a fallback decision to model-quant-v2 (low-cost variant) at 01:07:43 due to perceived low capacity. But pool still had capacity — KV cache warm state persisted. The quant variant isn't compatible with some runtime routing metadata and we saw connectors fail -> blackholing for some request types.

alice_oncall: immediate mitigation: disable automatic fallback policy for affected pool and pin routing to stable variant until we have clarity. Can someone run the command to update policy?

ben_sre: running policy patch now: ```clictl routing update --pool dp-west-3 --fallback-enabled false --comment "temp mitig: block automatic fallback until root cause"```

ops-bot: Command accepted. Routing policy updated for dp-west-3. Old policy preserved at /policies/2026-07-14-01-09-backup. :white_check_mark:

carol_runtime: pushing a targeted rollback for router decisioning to before 01:07:00 to undo variant switch logs. ```kubectl -n router exec -it router-control -- curl -XPOST http://localhost:8080/decisions/rollback?ts=2026-07-14T01:07:00Z``` Doing now.

dave_support: customer side: support ticker INC-4872 — several enterprise customers reported 502/504 and elevated latencies starting ~01:07. We're sending status update that mitigation in progress and that we're rolling back fallback policy.

alice_oncall: note: autoscaler telemetry ingestion had an outage for ~30s earlier due to transient spike in metrics pipeline. hypothesis: stale/duplicate heartbeat messages created a noisy capacity signal that tripped router logic.

ben_sre: checked raw metrics stream — there are duplicated heartbeat pings with identical epoch ids: ```{"pool":"dp-west-3","heartbeat_epoch":4032}``` repeated. Looks like a fanout retry bug from the ingestion proxy.

carol_runtime: that duplication would lower our moving-average capacity estimate (we treat duplicates as 0 capacity when mismatch) — explains why policy chose fallback. We'll add a quick filter in router to dedupe by epoch for 1 hour to stop oscillation while we patch ingestion. ```/etc/router/config: dedupe_heartbeat: true```

ops-bot: Router config set: dedupe_heartbeat=true (applied to dp-west-3) — reload triggered.

ben_sre: ingestion proxy fix is in progress in staging, pushing to canary for 10% of traffic: ```deploy ingestion-proxy v2.3.1-canary --filter pools=dp-west-3 --rate=10%```

alice_oncall: good. I'm handing off to ben for root-cause work after we stabilize. I'll stay on slack for any escalation and coordinate with support for customer comms. ben, you're primary; carol you're secondary.

ben_sre: acknowledged. Next steps: monitor pool_success_rate and router_fallback_rate. If fallback_rate < 5% and pool_success_rate > 95% for 10m, we'll mark mitigation complete and re-enable fallback with stricter threshold.

eva_platform: FYI finance/customer-ops flagged a high-value customer in dp-west-3 — will prioritize communication. dave, prep a customer note: timing, mitigation, next steps, ETA for full RCA.

dave_support: prepping note now. Draft: "We observed an elevated error rate beginning 01:07 UTC caused by an automated fallback policy triggered by duplicated autoscaler heartbeats; temporary mitigation applied, rollback executed, and we are deploying a fix to the metrics ingestion path. Expected RCA by EOD." Will post to INC-4872 and notify account teams.

ops-bot: Canary deployment reported: ingestion-proxy v2.3.1-canary healthy on 1/1 pods, 10% filter applied.

carol_runtime: router rollback succeeded, policy disabled, dedupe filter applied. Metrics look like they're returning to normal: fallback_rate down to 6% and trending.

alice_oncall: thumbs. Keep observing 15m then we'll decide re-enable. Also create a follow-up ticket: INGEST-214 to root cause retry fanout. Ben, please take it.

ben_sre: created INGEST-214 and assigned to me. Will attach logs and timeline. Also scheduling post-incident review with runtime/ingest teams 2026-07-14 15:00 UTC.

alice_oncall: handoff complete to ben_sre. I'll update PagerDuty and put an incident note. Leaving oncall channel but monitoring. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident state change: acknowledged -> mitigated. Mitigation timestamp: 1798889010. Incident severity: Sev2.

ben_sre: final note before we close thread: root cause provisional: ingestion proxy duplicate heartbeats -> noisy capacity_signal -> router fallback decision to incompatible quant variant -> partial traffic blackholing. Remediation: ingestion fix (INGEST-214), router dedupe short-term, stricter fallback thresholds, add unit test for duplicate heartbeat handling.

alice_oncall: agreed. Closing handoff. Will file postmortem doc and link to INCIDENTS/2026-07-14-phantom-capacity-echo.

ops-bot: Thread archived to incidents folder.
